hook.line: Detailers, I'm going to show you how to better your SEO. Three ways.
hook.visual: Phone filming a laptop showing his Google Business Profile, a hand points at the screen; white title 'Boost your detailing businesses google seo' across the top; one-word captions.

beats.what: Handheld shot of the laptop with his business profile on screen, title text over it, he calls out 'detailers'
Camera pushes toward the screen as he promises three ways
Tip one: a logo photo on the desktop, rename the file to a keyword like 'Kansas City detailing' before upload
Hand taps the upload into the profile: 'boom', it helps your key searches
Tip two over the profile page: get a review from every customer
Cut to the 'Add post' dialog: tip three, post a keyword-rich update weekly
Examples of post topics: ceramic coating, mobile detailing in Kansas City
Quick push-ins as he promises the three tips will boost your SEO

why_it_works: Opens by naming the niche ('detailers'), so the exact audience self-selects in the first second
Numbered promise (three ways) gives the viewer a progress bar in their head, so they stay for tip three
Each tip is shown on the real tool he uses (file rename, profile, add-post dialog), making it instantly doable
weaknesses: Phone-filmed laptop with glare and a hand often blocking the screen; the UI is barely readable
Long dead air while renaming the file (silence share 29.5%), around 19-28 s nothing is said
Title disappears after the first seconds and there is no CTA; the video just stops mid-sentence
One cut in 69 s, so the frame barely changes
for_robert: Steal the niche call-out opener ('Detailers, ...') plus a numbered promise, and give each tip a number card Fred holds up; avoid filming a screen with a phone, use a clean screen insert.
